# Zozo.pk — Mobile Phone Prices & Specifications in Pakistan

> Zozo.pk is Pakistan's premier mobile phone comparison platform, providing up-to-date prices, detailed technical specifications, retailer comparisons, PTA tax estimates, and user reviews across all major mobile brands.

## Main Navigation

- [Phone Catalog](https://zozo.pk/phones): Search, filter, and browse all mobile phones in Pakistan by brand, price, RAM, camera, and battery.
- [Mobile Brands](https://zozo.pk/brands): View all smartphone manufacturers and their complete phone lineups.
- [Phone Comparison](https://zozo.pk/compare): Compare two or more smartphones side-by-side on price, specs, display, processor, camera, and battery.
- [Tech News & Reviews](https://zozo.pk/news): Read latest mobile phone news, reviews, launch updates, and buying guides.
- [HTML Sitemap](https://zozo.pk/site-map): Complete index of all static and dynamic pages on Zozo.pk.

- [Mobiles under Rs. 150,000](https://zozo.pk/phones?max_price=150000): Flagship and high-performance smartphones.
